tei:div.tei:p: It was taught in a Boraysa: Rabbi Nosson says, While [the Kohein] ground [the incense] he would say, ‘Hodeik heiteiv, heiteiv hodeik,’ because the sound is good for the spices. If half the quantity of incense was prepared, it was acceptable; but we have not heard if only a third or a fourth [of it was prepared] [whether it was acceptable].”

tei:note.tei:p: Some suggest that the sound of these specific words affects the spices.
I.e., we did not hear our teachers expound this question.
